name: What is the typical process for drain backup repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for drain backup repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The drain backup repair process typically begins with a diagnosis to identify the cause and location of the blockage, often using a video pipe inspection. Once identified, technicians might use snaking tools, hydro-jetting (high-pressure water), or augers to clear the obstruction. For more severe issues like tree root intrusion or damaged pipes, excavation or trenchless repair methods may be required. Post-repair, the system is tested to ensure proper flow.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves diagnosing the cause, clearing the blockage with tools like snakes or hydro-jetting, and then testing the system.
